title: Vertical federated learning platform and methods for using same

pse.problem: The limitation is the need to build and train vertical federated machine learning models using datasets with different data schemas without directly accessing or receiving the raw data stored at the satellite sites.
pse.solution_function: The system performs distributed data analysis and model training by coordinating federated devices, each containing a local dataset with a unique data schema. The central authority collects encrypted data samples from each device, decrypts them using secure multi-party computation (SMPC) techniques, and integrates the combined data to build a global machine learning model.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include: 1. Federated devices with local datasets, 2. Secure communication channel for encrypted data transfer, 3. Central authority for orchestrating data collection, decryption, and model training.
pse.solution_implementation: The process involves: (a) federated devices encrypting their local dataset samples using public keys, (b) secure transmission of encrypted data samples to the central authority, (c) the central authority decrypting received samples with private keys using SMPC, (d) data integration and model training on the combined encrypted dataset, (e) the central authority encrypts the final global model parameters, and (f) the federated devices download the encrypted model parameters for local use.
pse.effect: The solution allows for building vertical federated learning models without compromising data privacy by avoiding direct access to raw data. It enables valuable analytics across datasets with different information about some of the same entities.
